description: Implementation of PayPal Express Checkout payment module handling transaction initialization, authorization, capture, and refund processes, integrating with PayPal API via eBay SDK classes.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implements payment processing methods for PayPal Express Checkout, including transaction init, authorize, capture, and refund.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that necessary API credentials are provided in the configuration.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Processes authorization using a PayPal payment token.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Creates a PayPal express checkout transaction, setting up payment details and obtaining a checkout token.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Processes authorization and capture in one step.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund transaction via PayPal API.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the core logic for executing a PayPal express checkout transaction, including API calls to get checkout details and complete payment.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction.
